dedupe_keys.name: edx wireless network planning software saas and desktop

description: EDX offers radio-frequency planning software, delivered as software as a service, in the cloud and on the desktop, for engineering complex wireless networks over large regions and dense environments. Its solutions pages cover smart-grid communications planning for advanced metering (AMI 2.0) and multiservice utility networks using Wi-SUN mesh, NB-IoT and private LTE, including integration of distributed energy resources; land mobile radio and critical communications networks with P25, TETRA and mission-critical services over LTE and 5G for public safety and disaster recovery; multi-orbit satellite non-terrestrial networks with link budgets and interference analysis in line with 3GPP Release 18 and later, for direct-to-device connectivity; fixed wireless access in millimetre-wave and mid-band spectrum; IoT and smart-city networks with 5G RedCap; and in-building neutral-host and private 5G networks with 3D ray-tracing. Coverage: worldwide use; the company is known for work with utilities and public safety agencies. Format and access: commercial SaaS and desktop software; consultations by booking. Caveats: proprietary; the website describes solutions, not model details or pricing. Simulation uses: coverage and capacity planning of utility, public safety and satellite links, emergency communication resilience and the interdependency of grid control with telecom networks. Related records: RadioPlanner and ATDI HTZ are comparable tools, and the Vienna 5G simulators are open research tools.
